name: Equator Beverage Company
summary: Equator Beverage Company engages in the product development, production, marketing, distribution, and sale of beverages. The company's flagship product is MOJO pure coconut water. It also produces sparkling coconut water, coconut water + mango juice, coconut water + pineapple juice, and pure organic coconut water. Equator Beverage Company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey.
